negative_reviews.author: James Newman
negative_reviews.text: Very poor service. One dish arrived 15 minutes before everyone else. Second dish arrived 8 minutes before the last two. Starters all arrived after mains and one starter necee arrived at all. Had to ask twice to amend the bill.

negative_reviews.author: Win Ho
negative_reviews.text:
The floor was quite slippery, so I raised the issue with the manager as I was concerned about the potential safety risk.

Unfortunately, his response was rather dismissive. He jokingly suggested that I only found the floor slippery because I was wearing expensive shoes, whereas he was wearing cheaper shoes and didn't find it slippery.

I wasn't bringing this up to complain about my shoes. I was simply concerned that the floor could be a safety hazard for customers. I found his response disappointing, as he seemed to brush off a genuine safety concern rather than take it seriously.
